content.text: By the end of this lesson, you should be able to:
Explain why sampling is necessary in ecology
Describe how to use quadrats and transects
Calculate species frequency, density, and percentage cover
Understand the importance of random sampling

is the collection of data from a subset of a population or area. In ecology, we cannot count every organism, so we use sampling techniques to estimate populations and study distribution. Proper sampling methods ensure our results are representative.
May harm organisms if all counted
Sampling where every individual or position has equal chance of being selected
